summary: SemEval-2026 Task 9 is focused on multilingual polarization detection. Specifically, it covers the identification of multilingual, multicultural and multievent polarization along three axes (in subtasks), namely detection, type, and manifestation. Online polarization presents a concern, because it is often followed by hate speech, offensive discourse, and social fragmentation. Therefore, its detection before it escalates is crucial for a safer and more inclusive online space. We have coped with this SemEval task by finetuning mid-size LLMs for the sequence-classification task using the QLoRA parameter-efficient finetuning technique. The training data augmented the multilingual (22 languages) training sets by anonymized, lower-cased, upper-cased, and homoglyphied counterparts, making the detection more robust.

AI.tldr: 本文是 SemEval-2026 Task 9（POLAR 多语言极化检测共享任务）参赛系统论文。作者（Kempelen Institute of Intelligent Technologies 与 ADAPT Centre，Trinity College Dublin）沿用其在 PAN@CLEF2025 机器生成文本检测任务中提出的 mdok 微调框架，用 QLoRA 对中型多语言大模型（Qwen3-32B 用于子任务1，Gemma-3-27B-pt 用于子任务2/3）进行序列分类微调，覆盖 22 种语言三个子任务（极化检测、极化类型、极化表现）。训练数据通过匿名化、全小写、全大写、同形异义字符替换四种增广方式各扩充 5%（共 +20%）以提升鲁棒性。系统总体在约三分之二的语言上优于官方基线，子任务1平均高约3%、子任务2高约4%，但多标签子任务2/3明显偏弱；排名上在62个“语言×子任务”组合中有14次进入前20%，仅意大利语子任务1获第1。此外论文探索了基于评价理论（ISEAR/deISEAR/enISEAR）的情感评价维度特征作为替代方案，效果有限但具潜力。
AI.motivation: 在线极化（online polarization）是仇恨言论、冒犯性话语与社会撕裂的前兆，在其升级前进行识别对构建安全、包容的网络空间至关重要。SemEval-2026 Task 9（POLAR）要求在 22 种语言上完成三个子任务：子任务1二分类极化检测；子任务2识别极化的社会维度（政治、种族/民族、宗教、性别/性取向、其他）；子任务3识别极化的修辞表现形式（刻板印象、污名化、非人化、极端语言、缺乏共情、否定）。作者此前在 SemEval-2024 Task 8 与 PAN@CLEF2025（mdok，机器生成文本检测，双子任务排名第一）中验证了“7B 级 LLM 微调优于传统 BERT 类小模型”的经验，希望将该方案迁移到多语言极化检测，并进一步解决多标签分类与低资源语言鲁棒性问题。
AI.method:
1) 数据准备：将所有语言训练样本合并训练，使模型关注任务而非语言；将官方 dev 集与训练集合并去重；子任务1按每语言每标签各100条构造验证集（22×200=4400条），子任务2/3按每语言伪随机采样100条以反映多标签分布。
2) 数据增广（子任务1）：每种技术复制原文后修改副本，再去重；包括匿名化（邮箱/@用户/电话替换为[EMAIL]/[USER]/[PHONE]）、全小写化、全大写化、同形异义字符替换（homoglyph 攻击，缓解分词扰动导致的规避），四种各增广5%，共使训练集扩大20%，以使判别对文本视觉形式不变、更聚焦语义。
3) 微调：QLoRA（4-bit 量化 + bitsandbytes，HuggingFace transformers），常数学习率 2e-5、warmup ratio 0.03、paged AdamW、batch size 1、每500步验证、单 epoch，按验证集最佳指标（AUC 用于子任务1，macro F1 用于子任务2/3）选检查点。
4) 基座模型：面向低资源语言的多语言模型，子任务1最终选 Qwen3-32B（支持>100语言）；子任务2/3因 Qwen3 多标签微调出现困难改用 Gemma-3-27B-pt（支持>140语言）。
5) 评价理论（appraisal）备选方案：基于 ISEAR 及 deISEAR/enISEAR（7类情绪、5个二元评价维度、4类事件描述），采用类似 AppraisePLM 的多任务回归架构、以 XLM-RoBERTa 编码器处理多语言输入，损失为 MSE 与 BCE 加权组合得到评价向量；再按语言分别训练 LogisticRegression（80/20 划分）预测极化，评估 macro F1 与逐标签 AUC。该方案因时间原因未进入最终提交系统。
6) 复现：基于 IMGTB 框架开源代码，实验使用 1×A100 64GB 约200 GPU 小时、1×H200 140GB 约100 GPU 小时。
AI.result: 子任务1（宏观F1）整体表现良好：最低 0.6293（高棉语），最高 0.9237（中文），尼泊尔语 0.8915、泰卢固语 0.8818、缅甸语 0.8788 表现较强；高棉语、尼泊尔语与中文在子任务2/3亦有较好表现（中文 0.8199/0.4912、尼泊尔语 0.8026/0.5669、乌尔都语 0.7791/0.8108），但豪萨语子任务3为 0.0000，意大利语/波兰语/俄语/缅甸语未纳入子任务3。相比官方基线，约三分之二语言更优，子任务1平均+3.26%、子任务2平均+4.25%、子任务3平均-0.08%（受豪萨语 0 分影响）；最大提升为印地语子任务3（+51%）。与其他参赛系统相比，62个语言×子任务组合中14次进入前20%、28次进入前50%，仅意大利语子任务1排名第1，子任务2最佳为尼泊尔语第3、乌尔都语第4，15次落入后20%。逐标签分析显示子任务2中“other”最难，子任务3中“非人化”“缺乏共情”“否定”误分类最严重。评价理论方案的整体 macro F1 明显低于微调方案（多在0.43–0.70区间，子任务2/3接近随机），但部分标签AUC较高（如高棉语“非人化”0.8948、尼泊尔语0.8801），说明情感-认知信号具有阈值无关的判别潜力。
AI.conclusion: 结论与未来工作：单一多语言统一模型可覆盖全部语言并取得有竞争力的表现，但语言间差异显著，部分语言上该方案不适用；多标签子任务明显比二分类子任务困难，未来可考虑按语言或相似语言分组分别微调；评价理论特征方案及其与纯微调检测器的融合值得进一步探索。局限：仅探索了少量基座模型（其他模型可能对某些语言更好）；仅在共享任务所含语言上测试，未评估向其他语言的泛化；训练数据限于官方 train/dev 划分，未利用其他公开数据集。

title: Improving Model Safety by Targeted Error Correction
comment: This work has been accepted for publication in the Proceedings of International Conference on Pattern Recognition (ICPR) 2026. The final published version should be cited
summary:
The widespread adoption of machine learning in critical applications demands techniques to mitigate high-consequence errors. Our method utilizes a dual-classifier GBDT pipeline to distinguish routine human-like errors from high-risk non-human misclassifications. Evaluated across three domains, animal breed classification, skin lesion diagnosis (ISIC 2018), and prostate histopathology (SICAPv2), our framework demonstrates robust safety improvements. To address real-world deployment concerns, our results confirm the pipeline introduces negligible inference latency (1.60% overhead for the animal dataset, 1.84% for ISIC, and 1.70% for SICAPv2) while outperforming traditional Maximum Class Probability (MCP) baselines in correction precision. Our conservative correction strategy successfully reduced dangerous non-human errors by 34.1% in ISIC and 12.57% in SICAPv2, improving super-class diagnostic safety to 90.41% and 92.13% respectively. This proves that safety-critical reliability can be substantially enhanced post-hoc without expensive model retraining.
  keywords: Error Analysis, Post-hoc Correction, Trustworthy AI.

AI.tldr: 本文（ICPR 2026，Pompeu Fabra + KTH）提出一种**免重训练、免推理期真值**的"后验错误纠正"流水线：在多分类基座模型（如 ResNet-50）之后接两个级联的 GBDT 分类器——①Error Detector 依据基座输出的类别概率向量判断"对/错"，②Error Type Classifier 判断该错误是"人类式混淆(human-like)"还是"非人类式严重错误(non-human)"；仅当两者同时触发时执行 Superclass Flip Policy，把预测强制翻转至语义上"更安全"的相反超类。三个用例（Oxford-IIIT Pet 猫狗 37 类、ISIC-2018 皮肤病变 7 类、SICAPv2 前列腺病理 4 类）结果：非人类错误分别下降 7.65% / 34.1% / 12.57%，超类（诊断）安全准确率分别达到 90.80% / 90.41% / 92.13%，细粒度准确率亦同步上升，且推理延迟开销仅约 1.6%–1.84%（每图 0.1 ms）。核心价值在于把"准确性导向"转化为"危害导向"，并以高precision低recall的保守门控换取"修复多于引入"的净收益。
AI.motivation: 交叉熵等标准训练目标把所有误分类等价惩罚，模型可以在整体准确率很高的情况下，仍频繁产生语义上荒谬、对人类而言"不可理喻"的错误（如把狗判成猫、把恶性黑色素瘤判成良性痣、把猫判成狗种）。这类由 Baeza-Yates 与 Estévez-Almenzar 形式化的 non-human errors 会侵蚀用户信任（algorithm aversion），在医疗诊断、自动驾驶等高后果场景中可能造成不可逆伤害；而相关研究多停留在"诊断问题"层面（置信度阈值、trust score、OOD 检测），只能标记不确定样本而无法真正修复。此外，以往依赖"oracle"标注错误的理想化实验无法落地——真实部署时系统拿不到真值标签。因此作者希望有一种可完全自动化、实时、不改动基座模型的后验纠错机制：只对高危的 non-human 错误施加干预，而保留"看起来合理"的人类式混淆。
AI.method:
**三级级联流水线（后验、可插拔、模型无关）**

1. **Base Classification**：统一使用 ImageNet 预训练 ResNet-50 + Adam(lr=0.001) + 交叉熵。数据集与超类映射为：(a) Oxford-IIIT Pet（12 猫 + 25 狗 = 37 类），自建 18,500 张网络来源测试集（每类 500 张，规模远大于训练集 7,393 张）；(b) ISIC-2018（7 类 → Benign{NV,BKL,DF,VASC} / Malignant{MEL,BCC,AKIEC}），测试用 15% 随机样本 1,512 张；(c) SICAPv2（NC→Benign，Gleason 3/4/5→Malignant），patch 级。

2. **Error Detector（Gatekeeper, 回答 RQ1）**：输入为基座输出的概率向量 p，用训练集上生成的概率向量训练 GBDT；标签 0=正确、1=所有误分类。对照基线为 MCP（最大类概率低于平均置信阈值即报警）。此阶段明确**以precision优先**，以避免把正确预测误拉去纠正。

3. **Error Type Classifier（回答 RQ2）**：仅在检测到错误时触发，仍以概率向量为特征，用第二个 GBDT 在"基座出错的训练样本"上训练；标签 0=human-like（预测类与真类同超类）、1=non-human（跨超类）。

4. **Superclass Flip Policy**：判定为 non-human 时，将预测重路由到相反超类集合 S_alt 中基座概率最高的类别：ŷ_final = argmax_{c∈S_alt} p_c。

5. **决策逻辑**：D=0 → 直接透传；D=1 且 T=0 → 保留原预测（避免过度纠正）；D=1 且 T=1 → 触发翻转。

6. **评估指标**：细粒度 class accuracy、超类 accuracy（动物/诊断安全，主安全指标）、MCC（应对类别不平衡）、检测器的 precision/recall/F1，以及端到端延迟开销。
AI.result:
**动物数据集（Pet 37 类）**：基座 class acc 76.86%、MCC 0.763、super-class acc 90.04%（1,843 个跨物种 non-human 错误：848 猫→狗、995 狗→猫；2,437 个人类式错误）。流水线后 non-human 错误 1,843→1,702（-7.65%），class acc 76.86%→77.64%，super-class acc →90.80%，MCC 0.763→0.771，正确样本 14,220→14,363（净救回 143 张）。Error Detector MCC 0.32 / precision 0.62 / F1 0.39（MCP：precision 0.51 / F1 0.61）；Error Type MCC 0.26。

**ISIC-2018（皮肤病变）**：基座 class acc 79.23%、诊断超类 acc 85.45%（314 错误中 220 = 70% 为 non-human：153 良性→恶性、67 恶性→良性）。流水线后 non-human 220→145（**-34.1%**），诊断安全准确率 85.45%→**90.41%**，class acc 79.23%→83.47%，MCC 0.667→0.723，正确预测 1,198→1,262（多纠正 64 例）。Detector acc 83.20%/MCC 0.42/precision 0.67（F1 0.49，MCP precision 0.446/F1 0.550）；Error Type acc 88.43%/MCC 0.70。

**SICAPv2（前列腺病理）**：基座 acc 68.43%、MCC 0.5489、超类 acc 91.00%（191 non-human + 479 human-like 错误）。流水线后 non-human 191→167（-12.57%），超类 acc →**92.13%**，class acc →69.18%，MCC 0.5596。Detector acc 68.28%/MCC 0.09/precision 0.49/F1 0.16（MCP precision 0.48/F1 0.51）——门控极为保守；Error Type acc 91.94%/MCC 0.84。

**其他发现**：human-like 错误在 ISIC(94→105) 与 SICAPv2(479→487) 中上升，作者解释为危险的 non-human 错误被"降级"为可理解的次级错误（同一良/恶性类别内混淆）。延迟：双 GBDT + 策略固定 0.1 ms/图，总推理时间增加 1.60%/1.84%/1.70%。相比直接训练的二分类超类模型（ISIC 用同一 ResNet-50 得 89.4% 准确率但 MCC 仅 0.67），该流水线在 MCC 上更优。
AI.conclusion:
**贡献与价值**：①提出模块化、模型无关、可实时运行的后验纠错级联，把"错误"从静态可识别对象转变为可分级、可定向修复的对象，在不重训基座的前提下提升安全关键可靠性，且开销 <2% 延迟、检测precision优于MCP基线；②在三个异质域（自然图像、皮肤镜、前列腺病理）验证了"只纠正 non-human 错误"的保守策略确实能实现"修复数 > 引入数"的净收益；③错误动态分析显示系统把部分恶性↔良性错误转化为同严重度内的轻误，符合临床辅助的容错需求。

**需要注意的局限与潜在质疑（作者自述+阅读判断）**：
- Error Detector 本身很弱（MCC 0.09–0.42，SICAPv2 上 F1 仅 0.16），流水线增益相当程度上依赖后续 Error Type 分类器（医疗域 MCC 0.70/0.84）；检测器召回低意味着大量真实 dangerous error 未被触发修正（ISIC 仅从 220 降到 145，SICAPv2 从 191 到 167），因此"34.1% 降幅"是相对保守基线的部分改善，实际残余风险仍高（诊断安全 90.41%/92.13%，未达临床可接受水平）。
- non-human 错误的定义是基于**结果**（跨物种/跨严重度），作者亦承认这无法刻画人与模型在决策机制（纹理 vs 形状）上的真实差异，且需要领域专家参与标注，跨域泛化受限。
- 训练期与测试期分布不一致：检测器在训练集概率向量上拟合，测试集为自建网络图像（动物，18.5k 更复杂）或 15% 随机子集（ISIC）/patch 数据（SICAPv2），存在明显分布偏移，可能解释 SICAPv2 上 Detector MCC 仅 0.09。
- 指标口径有轻微不一致（正文表格编号与文字引用偶有错位；MCP/GBDT 双向比较中 F1 实为下降，"优于MCP"仅限precision），以及动物域整体提升幅度较小（<1%）。
- 与 CLIP/DINO 等表征学习相比，事后纠错只触及输出层行为，未解决特征层面的语义混淆根因。

**未来方向**（作者提出）：引入基于不确定性的混合"转人工"策略、成本敏感学习、自适应阈值与置信度校准以优化纠错门控；通过无监督聚类/注意力图等行为分析动态学习错误分类体系以减少人工标注；扩展至NLP幻觉等跨域场景；并探索与更强表征学习方法的互补结合。

title: Mitigating Multimodal LLMs Hallucinations via Relevance Propagation at Inference Time
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have revolutionized the landscape of AI, demonstrating impressive capabilities in tackling complex vision and audio-language tasks. However, a critical challenge remains: these models often suffer from hallucinations, generating outputs that diverge from the provided perceptual inputs. This tendency stems from an inherent imbalance in modality utilization during inference, where the dominance of textual tokens undermines the potential of perceptual inputs. As a result, the model frequently resorts to textual language priors at the expense of grounded evidence. To tackle this issue, we propose Learning Inference-time Modality Enhancement (LIME), a training-free framework designed to bolster multimodal grounding by explicitly enhancing modality usage during decoding. LIME leverages Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) to quantify token-level contributions and defines a relevance-based objective that promotes increased reliance on perceptual inputs. This objective is enforced through inference-time updates to the model's key-value representations, without modifying model parameters or requiring additional training data. We evaluate LIME across multiple multimodal benchmarks in both vision and audio domains, demonstrating consistent reductions in hallucinations and enhanced grounding while preserving generation quality. Further analysis shows that LIME increases modality contribution and produces more localized and semantically aligned relevance patterns.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LIME（Learning Inference-time Modality Enhancement）：一个免训练的推理期框架，利用 Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) 计算 token 级相关性，并将其转化为一个「提升感知模态相关性」的自监督目标，通过在每个解码步梯度优化自注意力层的 key/value 表示（ΔK、ΔV），在不改动任何模型参数、不使用任何标注数据的前提下抑制多模态大模型的幻觉。作者声称这是首次将 LRP（传统的事后可解释性方法）用作 MLLM 推理期引导信号的工作。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型（MLLM）在视觉与音频-语言任务上表现突出，但存在严重的幻觉问题：生成内容与给定的图像/音频证据不一致。已有研究推测其根源是推理时模态利用失衡——文本 token 主导生成，视觉/音频 token 被严重忽视，模型退化为依赖语言先验（甚至在无输入时也能给出貌似合理的视觉描述）。但这类结论多由注意力权重或扰动输出等间接代理信号推断而来，无法直接回答「感知信息利用不足是否真正导致幻觉，抑或仅与幻觉伴随出现」。此外，现有免训练缓解方法（OPERA、VCD、ICD、AAD、MemVR、V-ITI 等）依赖启发式规则或代理信号，未显式量化各模态对最终预测的贡献。
AI.method:
**问题设定与相关性。** 将 MLLM 分解为感知编码器 + 投影层 + LLM 骨架；输入 token 划分为感知集 P 与文本集 T。定义 relevance 函数 Φ，将输出 logit z*_t 的贡献加性分解到各输入 token 上。采用 LRP 规则（Bach et al., 2015；实现用 AttnLRP，Achtibat et al., 2024）：z 规则（含 ε 稳定项）、softmax 竞争性再分配规则、注意力矩阵分解规则（对 A·V 双线性交互）、LayerNorm/RMSNorm 近似为恒等映射。定义 Φ_P、Φ_T 为感知/文本 token 的总相关性。

**目标函数。** 监督版本 L_rel^sup（Eq.2）以外部标注的查询相关感知子集 G 为正类，做交叉熵；免标注版本 LIME（Eq.3）将 G 松弛为全体感知 token 集合 P，得到自监督的相关性损失 L_rel(Δ)；并加入 KL 正则 L_KL（Eq.4），约束带扰动与不带扰动的下一 token 分布保持一致，以保留语言先验与解码稳定性。总目标：min_Δ L_rel(Δ) + λ·L_KL(Δ)。

**推理期优化。** 优化变量为所有 Transformer 层的 key/value 加性扰动 Δ={ΔK, ΔV}（全序列共享、层内跨注意力头共享，Δ 初始化为零），每个解码步用 Adam 做少量梯度步优化（因需经 LRP 反传二阶梯度），步后立即丢弃重置，扰动不跨时间累积。超参：7 步、学习率 3–5×10⁻⁴、λ=0.1、τ=0.1。

**理论分析（C.2）。** LRP 守恒律意味着优化只是「重分配」而非「创造」相关性；对 L_rel 求导得 g_Φ=(u−s)/τ，表明该目标本身偏好感知 token 上的均匀分布（stationary point 对应 s=u，落在 G 内的比例为 |G|/|P|），并不直接鼓励区域定位；KL 项在 Δ=0 附近按 Fisher 度量二次惩罚（Lemma 1），给出 Δ* = (1/λ)F⁺Jᵀg_Φ 与 δΦ ≈ (1/λ)S g_Φ，其中 S=J F⁺Jᵀ。即实际实现的相关性变化须经过冻结模型敏感度结构 S 的「过滤」，从而把目标偏好的宽泛方向集中到模型本来就敏感、且与查询证据相关的感知路径上，从而自发产生区域/时间定位。
AI.result:
**视觉基准（POPE/CHAIR/HallusionBench）。** LLaVA-1.5-7B 在 MSCOCO-POPE 上平均 Acc/F1 达 87.89/87.37，超过 OPERA(84.21/83.55)、VCD(82.27/83.16)、ICD(82.96/81.56)、MemVR(86.93/85.88)、V-ITI(87.0/84.98)，其中随机划分 Acc 90.27、Adversarial 提升最大（76.03→85.51）。A-OKVQA 上同样最优（87.33/87.15）。CHAIR 上 LLaVA-1.5 的 CHAIR_S 52→42.7、CHAIR_I 15.8→13、平均 32.7→27.85（召回 72，低于 MemVR 的 80.8，体现忠实度与覆盖率的权衡）；Qwen-VL-Chat 29.3→28.25 且召回提升；Qwen2.5-VL-7B 平均 17.35→14.7 且召回上升（唯一两项同升）。HallusionBench 上 fACC/qACC/easyA/hardA 均提升（LLaVA 17.9→19.24；Qwen2.5-VL 19.29→21.06）。Qwen2.5-Omni 与 MiniCPM-o 4.5 亦有一致提升。

**音频基准。** AHQA 上 Qwen2-Audio-7B-Instruct 的 F1 大幅提升（随机 26.78→50.27、Adversarial 20.24→37.08），Acc 56.19→63.36，优于唯一可比基线 AAD；SALMONN-7B 与 Qwen2.5-Omni 亦全面提升。AIR-Bench 语音/声音/音乐三域均改善（如 Qwen2-Audio 57.56→66.1、60.86→66.41，音乐略降 55.89→56.25 仍相当）。

**模态利用分析。** 感知利用率与相关性定位均提升：LLaVA-1.5 定位 0.29→0.351、利用率 0.10→0.17（7步）；Qwen2-Audio 定位 0.4→0.5、利用率 0.34→0.42。免标注 LIME 在 7 步时达到 LIME-Sup 相对基线增益的 81%（视觉）与 95%（音频），即无标注目标逐步逼近区域监督版本。

**干预性分析（C.1）。** 逐样本看，被纠正的样本相关性位移最大（利用率 +0.121、定位 +0.147），仍幻觉的样本位移最小（+0.031、+0.026），说明位移幅度与单个预测结果直接相关而非仅整体均值共变。方向/目标扫描给出单调序：Reverse-LIME-Sup < Reverse-LIME < Baseline ≈ Random < LIME < LIME-Sup（LIME +7.20 Acc，Reverse-LIME −0.59，抑制 G 更糟 −3.42，Random 仅 +0.11 ≈ 基线），证明增益来自「放大的是哪些 token 的相关性」而非扰动本身。

**消融与效率。** ΔK、ΔV 单独或联合优化均优于基线，联合最佳；λ 过大则效果退化，中间值最优。层作用域上全层最优，早层（0–8）优于中/后层；3 步已能获得大部分增益。开销：7 步时 LLaVA 速度降至 0.32 tokens/s（9.43× 慢于原始解码，OPERA 3.66×、MemVR 1.04×），峰值显存基本不变（34.75GB vs 26.24GB），5 步为较便宜的折中（88.78% Acc）。
AI.conclusion:
本文的核心贡献是把「后验解释方法」LRP 转化为「推理期控制信号」：通过 LRP 量化每 token 对预测的贡献，证明多模态幻觉与感知 token 相关性下降相关，且通过定向干预可以系统性地改变预测行为。LIME 用这一信号在解码期优化 key/value 表示，无需训练数据、无需改动参数、也无需空间/时间标注，却能同时提升感知利用率、把相关性集中到查询相关区域（视觉 patch / 音频时段），并在视觉与音频的多模型多基准上一致降低幻觉且保持生成质量，定位能力逼近区域监督的上界。

作者亦坦承局限：逐 token 步的 relevance 优化带来显著推理延迟（最高约 9.4× 减速），需为不同模型/任务调 λ、优化步数与层作用域等超参，因而在延迟敏感或资源受限场景的适用性受限。方向上，该工作把「模态利用失衡」从相关性假说提升为有机制解释（Fisher 度量过滤 → 自发局部化）的因果性干预，并为可解释性方法作为生成控制信号提供了新范式。

title: mdok-style at SemEval-2026 Task 10: Finetuning LLMs for Conspiracy Detection
comment: Accepted to the SemEval-2026 workshop of the ACL 2026 conference
summary: SemEval-2026 Task 10 is focused on conspiracy detection. Specifically, the goal is to detect whether a Reddit comment expresses a conspiracy belief. Our submitted mdok-style system utilizes data augmentation and self-training (to cope with a rather small amount of training data) to finetune the Qwen3-32B model for a binary text-classification task. The submitted system is very competitive, ranking in the 85th percentile (8th out of 52 submissions). The results shown that our approach, which originated in machine-generated text detection, can be used for conspiracy detection as well.

AI.tldr: 本文是 SemEval-2026 Task 10（PsyCoMark）子任务2（Reddit 评论二元阴谋论检测）的参赛系统论文。作者将原本用于机器生成文本检测的 mdok 方法迁移到阴谋论检测：以 Qwen3-32B 为底座，通过 QLoRA 参数高效微调，结合四种数据增强技术与自训练（伪标签）策略，最终在官方测试集上取得 0.78 的 Macro F1，在 52 支队伍中排名第 8（前 20%，第 85 百分位）。
AI.motivation: SemEval-2026 Task 10 (PsyCoMark) 旨在理解社交媒体（Reddit）对话中阴谋论的语言表达方式，包含两个子任务，作者仅参与子任务2——对英文 Reddit 评论做二元分类（是否表达阴谋论信念）。核心挑战在于官方训练数据规模很小（1,715 条正例、2,263 条负例），对 32B 级大语言模型而言数据严重不足；同时大模型直接零样本使用时可能存在幻觉与精度问题。作者的动机是复用其在机器生成文本检测（mdok，PAN@CLEF2025 冠军）中验证过的鲁棒微调流程（含训练数据混淆与匿名化增强、自训练），将其迁移到这一性质不同的分类任务上，以在有限标注数据下提升大模型微调效果。
AI.method: 1) 数据增强（4 种，各取 10% 与原数据混合后去重）：匿名化（将正则识别的邮箱、@提及、电话替换为 [EMAIL]/[USER]/[PHONE]，注意原始数据已含 [URL] 标签，该匿名化仅作为增强而非全局预处理）、全小写副本、全大写副本、同形异义字符替换（homoglyphation，用于缓解对分词/字符表示敏感的分类器被视觉相似字符攻击欺骗的问题）。2) 自训练：第一轮仅用官方训练集训练模型，对无标注的 dev/test 集预测，仅保留正类概率 ≥0.99 或 ≤0.01 的高置信样本作为“银标签”，与金标签合并后重训，以抑制误差传播。3) 微调：QLoRA（4-bit 量化 PEFT），transformers 库，paged adamw 优化器、余弦学习率 2e-5、warmup ratio 0.03、batch size 1、每 100 步验证、单 epoch，按验证集最佳 Macro F1 选 checkpoint；由于 dev 集无标签，从训练集每类留出 100 条作验证。训练集规模：增强+去重后 2,126 负/1,517 正，加入银标签后 2,575 负/1,881 正。4) 底座模型选择：在 Qwen3 与 Gemma-3 系列中对比（4B/12B/14B/32B 等），按组织方 dev 集评测（不含自训练）选定 Qwen3-32B。5) 推理时另试验将正类阈值调至 0.7。
AI.result: 官方 Codabench 测试集（子任务2，指标为 Macro F1）：Qwen3-32B_ST_th0.7 = 0.78（提交系统，排名第8）；Qwen3-32B_ST = 0.77；Qwen3-32B_th0.7 = 0.77；Qwen3-32B = 0.76；DeBERTa-Large = 0.75；Qwen3-14B-Base = 0.75；Gemma-3-1B-PT_ST = 0.75；Qwen3-4B-Base = 0.75；Gemma-3-12B-PT = 0.74；Gemma-3-1B-PT = 0.73；Qwen3-4B-Base_ST = 0.72；随机基线 = 0.50。前三名分别为 NJUST_KMG 0.89、AGAI 0.87、jia57 0.86，说明与最优系统仍有约 0.11 的差距。系统间差异极小，甚至最小的 DeBERTa（<0.5B）也达 0.75，性能-算力权衡良好。计算资源：1×A100 64GB，约 100 GPU 小时。
AI.conclusion: mdok 方法从机器生成文本检测成功迁移到阴谋论检测，数据增强+自训练的 32B 级 LLM 微调方案在共享任务中取得前 20%（85 百分位，第 8/52）的竞争性成绩，证明跨领域迁移可行；同时需注意检测性能与计算成本之间的权衡（DeBERTa 仅略低）。局限：仅探索了少量底座模型，可能存在更优选择；共享任务仅含英文数据，跨语言泛化性未评估；训练仅用官方数据，未引入其他公开语料。标注真值尚未发布，错误分析待后续开展。

title: Strategy-Aware Optimization Modeling with Reasoning LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate syntactically valid optimization programs, yet often struggle to reliably choose an effective modeling strategy, leading to incorrect formulations and inefficient solver behavior. We propose SAGE, a strategy-aware framework that makes Modeling Strategy explicit in both data construction and post-training. SAGE builds a solver-verified multi-strategy dataset and trains a student model with supervised fine-tuning followed by Segment-Weighted GRPO using a composite reward over format compliance, correctness, and solver efficiency. Across eight benchmarks spanning synthetic and real-world settings, SAGE improves average pass@1 from 72.7 to 80.3 over the strongest open-source baseline. With multiple generations, SAGE discovers more distinct correct formulations and improves component-level diversity at pass@16 by 19-29%. At the largest scale, SAGE produces more compact constraint systems with 14.2% fewer constraints than the baseline, consistent with solver-efficient modeling. Overall, these results show that making Modeling Strategy explicit improves automated optimization modeling. Code is available at https://github.com/rachhhhing/SAGE.

AI.tldr: SAGE 是一个"策略感知"的自动化优化建模框架：先把"建模策略"（如基于流、指派、时间索引等建模范式）显式化，用于构造经求解器验证的多策略训练数据，再通过 SFT + 分段加权 GRPO（Segment-Weighted GRPO）与"格式—正确性—求解效率"复合奖励对推理型 LLM 做后训练。模型输出遵循 <think>/<strategy>/<modeling>/<check> 结构化推理后再给出 Gurobi 代码。
AI.motivation: 运筹学工作流中真正的瓶颈不是调用求解器，而是把自然语言需求翻译成求解器可执行且求解高效的数学模型。现有 LLM 方法（提示/智能体流水线、以及基于优化的微调）虽能生成语法合法的代码，但关键的"建模范式/策略选择"始终是隐式的，导致：(1) 索引空间不一致等可执行性错误（如把变量定义在 (A,A) 上产生 KeyError）；(2) 同一问题存在多种正确但模型规模、松弛紧致度与求解性能差异巨大的建模方式，而现有训练目标只关注可执行与正确，缺少对效率的信号；(3) 训练数据缺少策略层推理过程，模型难以学习"如何选择范式"。因此需要一个把策略作为一等公民、在数据构造与后训练两端都显式化的框架。
AI.method: 两阶段框架 SAGE（Strategy-Aware Guided reasoning）。阶段一多策略数据合成：策略教师为每个 OR 问题提出 K 个候选建模策略，推理教师在 (问题, 策略) 条件下生成"策略对齐的推理轨迹 + Gurobi 代码"；随后做求解器验证与过滤（丢弃运行失败、意外不可行/无界、解与 ground truth 不符者），并用 LLM-as-Judge 对语义冗余策略去重，得到 (question, modeling reasoning, code) 三元组语料 D_SFT。阶段二后训练：先全参数 SFT（目标序列 y=[r,c]，标准自回归语言建模损失），再用 Segment-Weighted GRPO 强化学习。推理模板强制三段式 <think><strategy>（问题类识别、范式选择、核心变量与约束逻辑）/<modeling>（集合、参数、变量、目标、约束的实例化）/<check>（索引域/维度/逻辑耦合一致性与冗余检查）</think> 后接代码块。Segment-Weighted GRPO 在 GRPO 裁剪目标上按 token 所属段赋权（α_strategy=2.0 > α_modeling=1.5 > α_check/others=1.0），以改善长程推理中的信用分配。复合奖励 R = R_format（5 个结构组件各 0.2）+ R_outcome（执行失败 0、不可行 0.2、解错误 0.4、匹配真值 1.0）+ R_efficiency（仅当 outcome=1 时生效，1 − tanh(M/α_eff)；LP 用迭代次数，MILP 用 β_gap·Gap + β_nodes·Nodes 归一化加权和）。教师为 DeepSeek-R1，学生初始化自 DeepSeek-R1-distill-Qwen-14B（另有 Qwen3-8B 骨干），训练数据来自 OptMATH-201K 与 IndustryOR-3K，10 万条 SFT + 8000 条 RL；评测遵循 Xiao et al. 2025 的清洗基准协议，在 NL4OPT、MAMO(Easy/Complex)、NLP4LP、ComplexOR、IndustryOR、OptiBench、OptMATH 八个基准上评估。
AI.result: 1) Pass@1：SAGE-DS-14B 在八个基准平均 80.3%，将最强开源基线（StepORLM-Q3-8B 71.7%、SIRL-Q2.5-7B 72.7%）提升至 80.3%；也超过其教师 DeepSeek-R1（68.1%）与 GPT-4o（64.9%）。复杂类基准平均提升约 15.4%，优势主要来自复杂任务。2) Pass@K：在 ComplexOR/IndustryOR/OptMATH 上所有采样预算下均优于 SIRL 与 DeepSeek-V3，pass@16 分别达 0.72/0.86/0.71，且差距随 K 保持稳定。3) 多样性：pass@16 时组件级多样性（变量类型 2.33、约束类型 2.31、目标类型 2.08）高于 SIRL（1.80/1.80/1.74）与 DeepSeek-V3（1.94/2.03/1.81），提升约 19–29%；案例显示 pass@1 为连续流模型、pass@16 才出现单位时段 0-1 指派模型等不同范式。4) 效率：在 ComplexOR 七个问题按 ×1–×8 放大后，SAGE 求解时间更低、迭代数更少且差距随规模扩大；最大规模下约束数 100.6 比基线 117.2 少 14.2%，NNZ 503.9 亦更低，变量数略多（扩展型表述 trade-off，稀疏化约束矩阵带来效率）。案例中 SAGE 40 条约束 vs DeepSeek-V3 424 条，求解时间 0.0063s vs 0.0186s。5) 消融：去掉 RL 降幅最大（80.3→74.0）；去掉结构化模板 80.3→78.3；去掉分段加权退化为标准 GRPO 为 76.7；去掉效率奖励为 77.4；在 IndustryOR 上差距随难度（Easy/Medium/Hard）扩大。6) 骨干可扩展性：Qwen3-8B 版本平均 77.0%，同样领先同规模 SIRL/StepORLM。LLM-as-Judge 去重与人工审计一致率约 87%。
AI.conclusion: 把"建模策略"作为显式的一层规划与优化对象，能够同时提升自动化优化建模的正确性、可执行性、多样性与求解效率。SAGE 表明：solver 验证的多策略数据 + 结构化推理模板 + 面向策略段的信用分配 + 效率感知奖励，可让中小规模模型在复杂 OR 建模基准上超过更强通用模型与现有 RL 基线，并在更大规模实例上产出更紧凑、求解更快的模型。局限与后续方向可包括：效率度量与 α_eff/α_iter 等超参依赖问题类别与经验设定；LLM-as-Judge 去重仅 ~87% 人工一致；效率评估仅在 ComplexOR 的七类问题上做受控放大；变体实验显示"更多变量+更少约束"的稀疏化 trade-off 需进一步刻画；训练依赖教师模型生成与昂贵的求解器回传，扩展到非凸/多目标等更复杂范式仍待验证。

title: Adversarial Imitation Learning with General Function Approximation: Theoretical Analysis and Practical Algorithms
summary: Adversarial imitation learning (AIL), a prominent approach in imitation learning, has achieved significant practical success powered by neural network approximation. However, existing theoretical analyses of AIL are primarily confined to simplified settings, such as tabular and linear function approximation, and involve complex algorithmic designs that impede practical implementation. This creates a substantial gap between theory and practice. This paper bridges this gap by exploring the theoretical underpinnings of online AIL with general function approximation. We introduce a novel framework called optimization-based AIL (OPT-AIL), which performs online optimization for reward learning coupled with optimism-regularized optimization for policy learning. Within this framework, we develop two concrete methods: model-free OPT-AIL and model-based OPT-AIL. Our theoretical analysis demonstrates that both variants achieve polynomial expert sample complexity and interaction complexity for learning near-expert policies. To the best of our knowledge, they represent the first provably efficient AIL methods under general function approximation. From a practical standpoint, OPT-AIL requires only the approximate optimization of two objectives, thereby facilitating practical implementation. Empirical studies demonstrate that OPT-AIL outperforms previous state-of-the-art deep AIL methods across several challenging tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出「基于优化的对抗模仿学习」框架 OPT-AIL，首次在一般函数逼近（非表格、非线性）设定下为在线对抗模仿学习给出多项式级的专家样本复杂度与交互复杂度理论保证，同时给出可落地实现：奖励学习用在线（无遗憾）优化，策略学习用乐观正则化优化，派生出模型自由与模型基于两个变体（Algorithm 1/2），并在 DMControl 8 个任务上超越 HyPE、HyPER、CMIL、FILTER、PPIL 等深度 AIL SOTA 方法。
AI.motivation: 对抗模仿学习（AIL）在实践中依赖神经网络取得成功，但已有理论分析多局限于表格型（OAL、MB-TAIL）或线性函数逼近（OGAIL、BRIG）等简化设定，并依赖计数型/协方差矩阵型 bonus 等难以用神经网络实现的算法设计，导致理论与实践之间存在显著鸿沟。同时，在一般函数逼近设定下，BC 的复合误差问题仍未被理论化解，且 tabular 下已知的 O(H^{3/2}/ε) 专家样本复杂度与 horizon-free 模仿差距界在函数逼近下尚未推广。本文目标是在一般函数逼近下给出可证明高效、且可直接用深度网络实现的在线 AIL 方法。
AI.method: 核心框架 OPT-AIL 将对抗模仿拆成两个耦合优化问题。①奖励更新（第 3 行）：由于策略随迭代演化，奖励损失 V_r^{π^k} − V_r^{π_E} 事前不可知，故建模为在线随机优化问题，用无遗憾算法（如 FTRL、在线投影梯度、Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader）求解，误差记为 ε_opt^r；实践中 FTRL 最小化所有历史损失加梯度惩罚正则项，天然等价于 off-policy 奖励学习。②策略更新（第 4–5 行）：借鉴统一探索-利用目标的乐观正则化设计，model-free 变体最小化乐观正则化 Bellman 误差 BE^k(Q) − λ_Q max_a Q_1(s_1,a) 后取贪心策略；model-based 变体最小化乐观正则化负对数似然 NLL^k(P) − λ_P V^*_{P,r^k}，再在所学模型上规划。理论侧：用误差分解引理把模仿差距拆为奖励误差与策略误差；假设奖励类可实现、Q 类可实现且 Bellman 完备（模型自由）或转移类可实现（模型基于）、MDP 具有低广义 eluder 系数 d_GEC；用 ε-覆盖数刻画函数类复杂度，结合 martingale 集中（Freedman、Azuma-Hoeffding、指数 martingale）与 Hellinger 距离建立奖励误差、策略误差上界（Lemma 2–7），并按 λ_Q、λ_P 平衡偏差与方差得定理 1、2。实践实现：判别器（reward model）+ actor-critic（TD 损失 + 延迟目标网络 + 软目标 Q 减基线），模型基于版本额外维护 7 成员高斯动力学集成模型与模型内 rollout 数据。
AI.result: 理论：model-free 与 model-based OPT-AIL 均达到多项式复杂度——专家样本复杂度 Õ(H² log(max_h N(R_h))/ε²)，交互复杂度分别 Õ((H⁴ d_GEC log(max_h N(Q_h)N(R_h))+H²)/ε²) 与 Õ((d_GEC·H+H²) log(H max_h N(P_h;log))/ε²)，是首个在一般函数逼近下可证明高效的在线 AIL；相比 BC 的一般逼近界 Õ(H³ log|Π|/ε²)，专家样本复杂度在 H 因子意义上改进。实验（DMControl 8 任务、5 seed）：1 条专家轨迹时 MF OPT-AIL 平均回报 683.0（对比最佳 model-free 基线 HyPE 534.0，+163，约 +29%），MB OPT-AIL 691.4（对比 HyPER 613.4，+71，约 +11%），在 Cheetah Run、Walker Run/Stand 等低数据场景达到专家级或近专家性能；model-based 交互效率（200k 步）优于 model-free（500k 步）。奖励模型质量上，MF/MB OPT-AIL 与真实奖励的 Pearson 相关达 0.7763/0.7472，显著高于 FILTER 0.5868、CMIL 0.5748、HyPE 0.5458、HyPER 0.3386；消融显示去掉乐观正则化后收敛变慢，乐观项在 Finger Spin、Hopper Hop、Walker Run 上加速明显。
AI.conclusion: OPT-AIL 通过「奖励在线优化 + 策略乐观正则化优化」的分解，首次为一般函数逼近下的在线 AIL 给出首个多项式专家样本复杂度与交互复杂度保证，同时把理论对象（覆盖数、d_GEC、ε_opt）映射为只需近似优化两个目标的工程实现，从而在 DMControl 上以更低交互量取得优于现有深度 AIL 方法的表现，并解释了 off-policy 奖励学习与乐观探索的合理性。局限与未来方向：专家样本复杂度 Õ(H²/ε²) 仍弱于 tabular 下最优 Õ(H^{3/2}/ε)，且尚未获得与 tabular 结果类似的 horizon-free 模仿差距界；同时理论上依赖低 GEC 与可实现性假设、实践中依赖神经网络的近似优化精度与乐观超参 λ 的调节，存在理论与实现之间尚未闭合的环节。

title: Reinforcement Learning for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems through Orchestration Traces
summary:
As large language model (LLM) agents evolve from isolated tool users into coordinated teams, reinforcement learning (RL) must optimize not only individual actions but also how work is spawned, delegated, communicated, aggregated, and stopped. This paper studies RL for LLM-based multi-agent systems through orchestration traces: temporal interaction graphs whose events include sub-agent spawning, delegation, communication, tool use, return, aggregation, and stopping decisions.
  Using this lens, we identify three technical axes. First, reward design spans eight families, including orchestration rewards for parallelism speedup, split correctness, and aggregation quality. Second, reward and credit signals attach to eight credit- or signal-bearing units from token to team; explicit counterfactual message-level credit remains especially sparse in our curated pool. Third, orchestration learning decomposes into five sub-decisions: when to spawn, whom to delegate to, how to communicate, how to aggregate, and when to stop. In our curated pool as of May 4, 2026, we found no explicit RL training method for the stopping decision.
  We connect academic methods to public industrial evidence from Kimi Agent Swarm, OpenAI Codex, and Anthropic Claude Code. The resulting scale gap is a gap between publicly reported deployment envelopes and open academic evaluation regimes, not independent verification of industrial training traces. We release the artifact at https://github.com/xxzcc/awesome-llm-mas-rl, including an 84-entry tagged paper pool, a 32-record exclusion log, scripted corpus statistics, and a minimal JSON schema for replayable orchestration traces.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇综述/立场型分类论文，核心贡献是提出“编排轨迹（orchestration trace）”作为分析 LLM 多智能体系统（LLM-MAS）强化学习与后训练的统一抽象对象，并据此建立三条分类轴：八族奖励设计（R1–R8）、八级信用/信号承载单元（team→orchestrator→role→agent→turn→message→tool→token）、五个编排子决策（O1 何时生成子代理、O2 委派给谁、O3 如何通信、O4 如何聚合、O5 何时停止）。作者同时给出工业—学术桥接（Kimi Agent Swarm/PARL、OpenAI Codex、Claude Code）与可机械检验的开放artifact（84条标注文献池、32条排除日志、统计脚本、编排轨迹 JSON Schema 与校验器）。
AI.motivation: 单智能体 LLM RL 优化的是 token/工具调用序列组成的轨迹；当 LLM 从“孤立的工具使用者”演化为协同团队时，RL 必须同时优化工作如何被派生（spawn）、委派（delegate）、通信（communicate）、聚合（aggregate）与终止（stop），而这些都不是单策略轨迹所能表达的。已有综述分别覆盖 LLM-MAS 架构/协作机制、单智能体 agentic RL（500+篇）、经典 MARL 与 agentic reasoning，但没有任何工作同时三角覆盖“多智能体 × RL后训练 × LLM agent”这一交集。此外，学术界普遍在 T≲10² 的短轨迹上训练，而工业界已公开报告 10³–10⁴ 步、10²–10³ 子代理的部署包络，存在未被审计的规模与 harness 落差；且在奖励族、信用粒度、停止决策三处存在可测量的空白。
AI.method: （1）语料构建：四阶段策展——由相邻综述种子化，在 arXiv/ACL Anthology/OpenReview/官方项目页按查询族检索，做前后向引文追踪，再按三条纳入规则（训练或后训练 LLM-MAS 组件 / 公开接口约束 RL 设计的工业系统 / 后文用作载荷的基准、安全案例或 MARL 原语）审计；116 条候选中保留 84 条、记录 32 条排除，逐条打 18 字段标签（category、is_rl、reward_type、credit_granularity、orchestration_form、verified 等）。（2）形式化抽象：把 Dec-POMDP 扩展为 dynamic-Dec-POMDP ℳ⁺（时间索引的代理集、spawn/despawn 动作空间、角色与轨迹历史条件化的动作集），把编排轨迹定义为带根、带顶点/边标签的时序事件图 G=(V,E,ℓ_V,ℓ_E)，顶点为 orchestrator 决策/spawn/message/tool/return/aggregate 事件；价值函数以轨迹前缀 G≤t 为条件（Bellman 恒等式中后继子图可能因 spawn 而扩张）。提出两个非正式“组织性论断”：均匀信用下的信用扩散（长轨迹下逐决策信噪比衰减）与编排器 spawn 决策的同前缀反事实不可识别（未实现分支无 on-policy 覆盖）。（3）三条分类法与交叉表：奖励八族（共享结果/个体/角色/过程PRM/工具/辩论验证/编排/混合）及其 hacking 风险；信用八级单元层级与二维表格（各方法的机制、是否支持动态代理数）；编排五子决策 O1–O5 及三种编排器训练范式（冻结子代理、联合共享基线、解耦中心 critic）。（4）证据分层与工程约束：区分同行评审方法、公司技术报告、产品文档、工程案例的“可用/不可用”边界；建立 rollout 成本形式 C_rollout≈Σ(L_i·c_tok+T_i·c_tool)+C_orch，以及 harness 作为“训练期冻结接口”的形式化约束 π_θ(·|o)=LLM_θ(·|harness(o))、a∈A_harness；用 SNR 代理刻画长轨迹信用脆弱性。（5）基准审计：E1 任务成功率/E2 并行效率/E3 协作质量/E4 协议开销四维，定义“MAS-native”为至少覆盖三维，并给出 B1–B5 基准设计建议、最小 trace 报告 schema 与指标操作定义。
AI.result: 语料统计（脚本生成）：84 条保留条目中 42 个 RL 方法、18 个基准、10 个经典 MARL 基础、6 个工业案例；RL 相关性 49 yes/9 partial/26 no。奖励族以 hybrid(15)、shared(10)、orchestration(7)、verifier(6) 为主，33 条为 NA。信用粒度严重偏斜：agent 23、role 10、orchestrator 8、turn 5、message 仅 2，而 36 条 NA——其中只有 C3 一篇做显式反事实 message 级信用（Debate-as-Reward 只是 message 级奖励信号）；编排形式上 centralized 18、hierarchical 13、debate 8、swarm 4、harness 3。最强实证发现之一：O5“何时停止”在策展池中找不到任何显式 RL 训练方法，现有做法要么由外部验证器终止、要么固定步数上限。其余结论包括：（i）编排奖励 R7 是相对单智能体 agentic RL 最具新增性的族，且其权重在训练中非恒定——Kimi PARL 报告 r_orch = r_perf + λ₁r_parallel + λ₂r_finish，两个辅助项被退火至零，作为“临时脚手架”；（ii）所有 R8 混合权重均为手调，池中无按梯度量级/奖励方差自动平衡的机制；（iii）工程侧三类约束（rollout 成本随 K 与 |G| 增长并叠加 GRPO 的 G 倍采样放大、harness 边界仅 Agent Lightning 显式建模、长轨迹下逐决策 SNR 衰减）共同解释了为何 T≲10² 的学术结果不能直接外推到 Kimi 报告的 T~10³–10⁴ 包络；论文明确把规模差距定性为“公开部署包络 vs 开放学术评估制度”的落差，而非对工业训练轨迹的独立验证（Codex/Claude Code 仅作部署形态与 harness 约束证据）；（iv）奖励 hacking 归纳为五类：伪并行、搭便车/懒代理、通信填充、工具刷量、验证器串谋；（v）编排学习失败模式：串行坍缩、单主导代理坍缩、过度通信、聚合泄漏、训练—推理拓扑不匹配；（vi）安全侧按信用层级组织八类攻击面，其中 orchestrator/role 层与沙箱层几乎空白，且无任何工作把“中途可控性（steerability）”形式化为 RL 目标；（vii）基准侧无任何开放基准同时覆盖 E1–E4 并在 10³ 步量级评测。全文给出 15 个开放问题（P1–P5 算法、P6–P8 奖励、P9–P11 系统、P12–P14 安全、P15 评测），并指认 P1（信用扩散）、P4（未实现分支反事实）、P15（MAS-native 基准）为最具杠杆的三项。
AI.conclusion: 论文的立场是：LLM-MAS 的 RL 文献应当沿“信用与信号承载单元层级”阅读，而非按“多智能体 RL 小技巧”平铺；编排轨迹（作为动态 Dec-POMDP 的事件图）是目前最干净、且尚未被惯例固化的组织性抽象，奖励设计与信用分配是一枚硬币的两面（稠密奖励与细粒度信用分解互为对偶，各自把同一份工作放在账本的不同侧）。由此推出三条近期方向：(1) 在编排图上建立统一的信用分配形式化，优先填补显式反事实 message 级信用与显式 orchestrator 级信用两个稀疏列，并解决跨层级组合时的“信用重复计数”问题；(2) 构建测量协作而非仅测量成功率的 MAS-native 基准（含 T 分层、拓扑可变性、对抗对照、公开可回放轨迹），否则新信用方法无法公平比较、规模主张无法交叉验证；(3) 面向部署的安全与可控长时程编排器（中途人类干预、跨代理注入、动态 spawn 下的沙箱隔离），目前只有 MAGIC 一类训练期攻防博弈触及。论文自陈其局限：语料为策展而非穷尽、标签由单人标注且未做一致性检验、工业来源不可复现、两条“论断”为组织性论证而非定理、图示为示意而非拟合曲线；且文献截止 2026-05-04，消息级信用、orchestrator 级信用、自适应 deliberation 与轨迹级安全四格可能很快被填补。

title: Double Rectified Linear Unit-based Modular Semantics for Quantitative Bipolar Argumentation Framework
summary: Quantitative Bipolar Argumentation Frameworks (QBAFs) provide an alternative approach to computing argument acceptability in Bipolar Argumentation Frameworks (BAFs). Each argument is assigned an initial strength, which is then updated to a final strength by considering the influence of both its attackers and supporters. Over the years, several semantics have been proposed to compute argument acceptability in QBAFs, yet they often yield divergent or counterintuitive results, even for simple acyclic cases. We introduce novel gradual semantics for QBAFs that address these limitations, producing results that align more closely with intuitive expectations, while satisfying established rationality postulates from the literature. Furthermore, we study its convergence behavior, proving that it converges not only for acyclic QBAFs but also for broader classes of cyclic frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文针对量化双极论证框架（QBAF）提出两种新的模块化（modular）渐进语义：改进二次能量语义 mqe 与基于 Double ReLU（DReLU/clamp）影响函数的 drl（以及可微版本 ddrl）。核心是引入归一化聚合函数 δ_q（q∈{max,sum}），用支持者强度和与攻击者强度和作分母修正"和式聚合"，使大量攻击/支持相互抵消时能反映均衡直觉；同时满足匿名性、稳定性、中立性、单调性、开放心灵等 12 条公理化原则，并给出无环线性收敛、含环情形的收敛充分条件与拓扑保证。
AI.motivation: QBAF 的既有渐进语义（mlp、reb、dfq、qen 等）虽在多数公理化原则上表现良好，却在最简单的无环框架上给出反直觉结果：例如 mlp 与 reb 在 τ=1 时完全不受攻击者影响（ρ(g)=1），dfq 在 Δ2 中给出 ρ(g)=0 而与 τ_g 无关、且多攻击多支持时 π=0 使 ρ(g)=1，qen 在支持与攻击近乎均衡时仍固定给出 0.2（因为和式聚合无法刻画均衡）。此外，MLP/reb/qen 类语义为保证收敛而"过度保守"（如 reb 的 ρ≥τ²），削弱了开放心灵原则，且自身收敛条件苛刻。作者因此寻求：既避免上述病态行为、又能给出更一般的收敛保证的新式语义。
AI.method: 1) 语法与背景：回顾 BAF/QBAF 定义 Δ=⟨A,R,S,τ⟩、模块化语义（聚合函数 α + 影响函数 ι）、DF-QuAD、Restricted Euler Based、Quadratic Energy、MLP 四种语义及其反例。2) 新聚合函数：α⁺(a)=Σ支持者ρ、α⁻(a)=Σ攻击者ρ，定义 δ_q(a)=α(a)·|α(a)|/q(α⁺,α⁻)，q∈{max,sum}，保持符号不变且对 α 单调，δ_sum≤δ_max≤α。3) 新语义 mqe：以 δ_q 替换 qen 中的 α，E_q=δ_q²/(1+δ_q²)，按 δ_q≤0 或 >0 分段更新。4) 新语义 drl：引入 DReLU(z)=max{−1,min{1,z}}（即 clamp/饱和线性传递函数），ρ_q(a)=(DReLU((2τ_a−1)+γ·δ_q(a))+1)/2，γ 控制攻击/支持相对初始强度的权重。5) 可微版本 ddrl：定义 dDReLU_k(z)=(1/k)ln((1+e^{k(z+1)})/(1+e^{k(z−1)}))−1，证明其为奇函数、严格单调、无穷可微且 lim_{k→∞} dDReLU_k = DReLU，取 k=100 使误差 <10⁻³。6) 理论分析：公理后设检验（12 条原则）、收敛性（无环线性时间；一般框架可能振荡不收敛；ddrl 收敛充分条件 γ<2/(3d)（q=sum）、γ<1/d)（q=max），d 为最大入度；每参数至多处于一个环时对任意 γ 收敛；mqe 借用 qen 的收敛结论，L_δ_sum=3d、L_δ_max=2d）。7) 实验：生成 6 组共 600 个递增攻击/支持规模的 QBAF 及 100 个随机无环 QBAF，与四种已有语义对比 |ρ(g)−τ_g|；对 γ 做 0–3 步长 0.25 的敏感性扫描；将语义实现于 Attractor Java 库，在 qen 基准数据集（30 组 × 100 个 QBAF，n∈{100,…,3000}）上评估收敛率与运行时间。
AI.result: 新语义成功修正既有反例：Δ2（τ_g=τ_a1=1，单攻击）下 drl 给出 ρ(g)=0.5，符合"初始强度与攻击者等权平衡"的直觉；Δ5（双攻击+单支持全强度）下不再出现 ρ=1 的异常。mqe 在 Δ7 系列中随支持者数量 n 增大给出 0.2→0.5→0.9 的合理演化（max 版为 0.2→0.36→≈0.75），而 qen 恒为 0.2。公理检验中 mqe、drl、ddrl 满足全部 12 条原则（匿名性、独立性、方向性、等价性、稳定性、中立性、单调性、强化、弱化、增强、对偶性、开放心灵），而 dfq 违反其中 8 条、mlp 违反 4 条、reb/qen 仅违反开放心灵。实验中 mlp/reb/qen 的 |ρ(g)−τ_g| 呈平坦曲线，dfq 与新语义呈下降趋势；δ_sum 恒低于 δ_max（如 n=1000 时 δ_sum=−0.002、δ_max=−0.004）；γ 越小偏移越小，γ=1 时初始强度与外部影响等权。收敛方面：ddrl 在 γ<2/(3d)（sum）或 <1/d（max）时保证收敛，该条件为充分非必要（γ=2/3 在 d=2 时仍收敛）；每参数至多一个环时任意 γ 收敛；基准数据集上各新语义对至少 95% 的 QBAF 收敛，运行时间随规模次线性增长。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的 mqe、drl 及其可微变体 ddrl 在消除既有效应性缺陷的同时满足全部既有理性公理（包括开放心灵），并把收敛保证从"仅无环"扩展到满足入度约束或受控拓扑（每参数至多一环）的更广含环类，且在随机与基准数据集上表现出稳定、可调的近线性/次线性效率。局限与展望：仅分析了四种代表性语义，其他模块化语义留待未来；δ_q 中以 |δ_q| 替代 δ_q² 的 mqe 变体、更多保证收敛的拓扑类、加权边与 [−1,1] 强度范围（可直接删去拉伸压缩步骤）、结构化论证（如基于假设的论证）适配、以及利用大语言模型构建 (QB)AF 的神经符号方向均留作未来工作；理论部分还提到可用微分方程的连续模型 ρ̃ 替代离散迭代（已在 Attractor 库中实现 ddrl/mqe 的这一方案）。

title: Beyond ECE: Calibrated Size Ratio, Risk Assessment, and Confidence-Weighted Metrics
summary: Confidence calibration has been dominated by the Expected Calibration Error (ECE), a linear metric that counts calibration offset equally regardless of the confidence level at which it occurs. We show that ECE can remain small even under arbitrarily large overconfidence risk, so we propose Calibrated Size Ratio (CSR) instead, an interpretable metric that equals 1 under perfect calibration, from which we derive the risk probability $P_{\mathrm{risk}}$ that quantifies the statistical evidence for overconfidence. We further argue that overconfidence risk assessment must be complemented by a measure of discriminative value: whether the assigned confidences actively distinguish correct from incorrect predictions. We show that confidence-weighted accuracy $\mathrm{cwA}$ is the natural such complement, and that confidence-weighting extends to all standard classification metrics. In particular, we prove that the confidence-weighted AUC (cwAUC) captures the information about calibration while the classical AUC cannot. We validate the proposed indicators on several synthetic confidence distributions under multiple controlled calibration profiles and on fifteen real datasets with and without post-hoc calibration. Experiments demonstrate that CSR achieves near-perfect sensitivity and specificity across all tested conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文批评 ECE 是线性度量、对高置信区间的失准不敏感，提出 Calibrated Size Ratio（CSR）：完美校准时等于 1，可由正态近似得到标准差 σ_CSR，进而得到风险概率 P_risk=Φ((CSR−1)/σ_CSR)；同时提出 Confidence-Weighted Accuracy（cwA）衡量置信度的判别价值，并把置信度加权推广到所有分类指标，特别是证明 cwAUC 携带经典 AUC 无法提供的校准信息。实验（10 类合成分布×8 种校准模式、15 个真实数据集）显示 CSR 能近乎完美地区分安全与危险置信度剖面，并揭示 ECE/等张校准等标准方法可能产生危险的过度自信。
AI.motivation: 置信度校准长期以 ECE 为标准，但 ECE 是线性度量：无论失准发生在哪个置信水平，δ=0.05 的偏差都被等同计数。由于低置信区间样本占比最大，ECE 实际由最不危险的区域主导，而对高置信尾部（后果最严重处）系统性盲视。作者进一步论证：即使过度自信风险任意大，ECE 仍可保持很小（Proposition 5 构造出 ECE<1/N 但 CSR>任意 Λ 的配置），因此低 ECE 不提供任何风险保证。同时，风险评估还需要补充一个“判别价值”维度——置信度是否能区分正确与错误预测；作者指出经典 AUC 对置信度的任何单调重标定不变，故完全不携带校准信息。
AI.method: 1) CSR 定义：CSR = E_D[(1−1[ŷ=y])/(1−conf)] = (1/N)Σ_{ŷ≠y} 1/(1−conf)，在“逐点完美校准”下等于 1，过度自信时 >1，不足自信时 <1；要求 conf<1。2) 风险量化：由完美极限校准下 Var(CSR) = (1/N)E[conf/(1−conf)] 给出 σ_CSR，取 z=(CSR−1)/σ_CSR，风险概率 P_risk=Φ(z)（正态上尾，无需 ECD/T-Cal 的蒙特卡洛重采样）。3) cwA：cwA = E[conf·1[正确]]/E[conf]，等于 p̄ + Cov(conf,1[正确])/c̄；oracle 情形为 1，平坦置信为 p̄。4) 置信度加权推广：定义 cwTP/cwFP/cwFN/cwTN/cwP/cwN，证明其满足与经典混淆矩阵相同的四条结构关系（Proposition 11–12），因此精确率、召回率、F1、MCC 等所有由 TP/FP/FN/TN 代数组合的指标均可置信度加权；并有 Σ_k cwAcc^(k) = (K−2)+2·cwA。5) cwAUC：证明其具有按置信度比例加权的成对概率解释（Proposition 15），且 cwAUC^(k)−AUC^(k) = Cov(w_ij,z_ij)/E[w_ij]，其中 w_ij=conf_i(ŷ_i)·conf_j(ŷ_j)；Proposition 17 证明 AUC 对任意严格单调递增变换不变，故 AUC 不含校准信息，而 cwAUC 敏感于置信度幅值。
AI.result: 合成实验：10 种置信度分布（Uniform、Skew Hi/Lo、Bimodal、Tight Hi/Lo、Normal、Log-Uniform Hi/Lo、Bell）× 8 种校准模式（Perfect、Underconf、Overconf 1−√(1−c)、0.5c、Random over/under c、Random 0.5），N=100~10^6，每组 100 次重复。在完美校准下 CSR 偏离 1 纯属有限样本噪声，1σ 阈值误报 9.77%（理论 15.87%，偏保守），3σ 阈值在 N=100 时 0.70%（高于理论 0.13%，说明小样本高斯近似低估尾部），N=10^6 时降至 0.30%，符合中心极限趋势；平均 P_risk 均低于 50%。P_risk 能稳定分离过度自信模式（多分布达 100%）与完美/不足自信模式（多分布 0%）。cwA 在所有情形均高于 Acc，增幅随置信质量集中于两极而增大（Bimodal 约 62%）。真实数据：15 个数据集（10 个 UCI 二分类 + CIFAR-10/Covertype/Obesity/Wine/MNIST）用 XGBoost 建模，验证集上分别做 isotonic 与 Platt 校准。原始输出下 6/15 数据集呈风险；isotonic 校准把 cwA 提高到最高（0.8841）却把风险大幅推高（11/15 超 1σ、10/15 超 3σ，多个数据集 CSR>10^5，如 breast_cancer 达 2.6×10^6），原因是等张回归的纯正/纯负平台被赋值为 1 或 0；Platt 最安全（3/15 超 1σ、0/15 超 3σ）且 cwA 具竞争力。综合排序 cwAUC(isotonic)>cwAUC(raw)>cwAUC(Platt) 与 P_risk(isotonic)>P_risk(raw)>P_risk(Platt)，表明 cwA/cwAUC 对过度自信风险同样不敏感，与 CSR 互补。cwAUC 在合成完美/不足自信模式下 9/10 分布高于 AUC，随机 0.5 模式下 10/10 低于 AUC；真实数据上 ΔAUC 提升较小甚至为负（因 AUC 本身已高、置信度为判别分数的变换）。ECE15/Brier/ECD/TCE/T-CAL/MCalDist/CWSA 等指标一并报告，结果显示以 ECE 为目标的校准方法可能产生风险剖面。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出两个简单可解释、互补的指标：CSR 用于度量置信度剖面的“风险”维度（完美校准时为 1，并可给出危险性的统计证据 P_risk），cwA（及其推广到所有分类指标的置信度加权版本，特别是 cwAUC）用于度量置信度的“有用性/判别价值”维度。论文证明 ECE 对风险完全不敏感——可以构造 ECE 为 0 甚至任意小而风险任意大的模型——而 CSR 能把“安全”与“危险”剖面清晰分离；真实数据进一步表明以最小化 ECE 为目标的标准后校准方法（尤其是 isotonic）可能产生危险的置信度剖面，因此推荐用 CSR/cwA/cwAUC 组合替代或补充 ECE 来评估置信度。局限包括：conf 接近 1 时的数值稳定性与方差膨胀未深入分析；风险结论仅在评估集为极限分布 i.i.d. 样本的前提下成立，部署后分布漂移会使 P_risk 失效；小样本下高斯近似的有限样本校正（Student-t、Edgeworth）未详研；尚未验证这两个指标是否足以完整刻画置信度剖面，也未探索用其指导后校准（而非仅评估）的用法。

title: FlexSQL: Flexible Exploration and Execution Make Better Text-to-SQL Agents
summary: Text-to-SQL over large analytical databases requires navigating complex schemas, resolving ambiguous queries, and grounding decisions in actual data. Most current systems follow a fixed pipeline where schema elements are retrieved once upfront and the database is only revisited for post-hoc repair, limiting recovery from early mistakes. We present FlexSQL, a text-to-SQL agent whose core design principle is flexible database interaction: the agent can explore schema structure, inspect data values, and run verification queries at any point during reasoning. FlexSQL generates diverse execution plans to cover multiple query interpretations, implements each plan in either SQL or Python depending on the task, and uses a two-tiered repair mechanism that can backtrack from code-level errors to plan-level revisions. On Spider2-Snow, using gpt-oss-120b, FlexSQL achieves a 65.4\% score, outperforming strong open-source baselines that use stronger, larger models such as gpt-o3 and DeepSeek-R1. When integrated into a general-purpose coding agent (as skills in Claude Code), our approach yields over 10\% relative improvement on Spider2-Snow. Further analysis shows that flexible exploration and flexible execution jointly contribute to the effectiveness of our approach, highlighting flexibility as a key design principle. Our code is available at: https://github.com/StringNLPLAB/FlexSQL

title: On Training Large Language Models for Long-Horizon Tasks: An Empirical Study of Horizon Length
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise as interactive agents that solve tasks through extended sequences of environment interactions. While prior work has primarily focused on system-level optimizations or algorithmic improvements, the role of task horizon length in shaping training dynamics remains poorly understood. In this work, we present a systematic empirical study that examines horizon length through controlled task constructions. Specifically, we construct controlled tasks in which agents face identical decision rules and reasoning structures, but differ only in the length of action sequences required for successful completion. Our results reveal that increasing horizon length alone constitutes a training bottleneck, inducing severe training instability driven by exploration difficulties and credit assignment challenges. We demonstrate that horizon reduction is a key principle to address this limitation, stabilizing training and achieving better performance in long-horizon tasks. Moreover, we find that horizon reduction is related to stronger generalization across horizon lengths: models trained under reduced horizons generalize more effectively to longer-horizon variants at inference time, a phenomenon we refer to as horizon generalization.

title: Federated Semi-Supervised Graph Neural Networks with Prototype-Guided Pseudo-Labeling for Privacy-Preserving Gestational Diabetes Mellitus Prediction
summary: Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) is a high-prevalence pregnancy complication that requires accurate early risk stratification to reduce maternal and fetal morbidity. However, real-world clinical deployment of machine learning is hindered by two coupled constraints: (i) label scarcity, where a large fraction of electronic health records (EHR) lack confirmed diagnostic labels, and (ii) data privacy, which prevents sharing patient-level data across hospitals. This paper proposes FedTGNN-SS, a privacy-preserving federated semi-supervised framework for clinical tabular EHR. Each hospital builds a local k-nearest-neighbor patient similarity graph and trains a topology-adaptive GNN encoder. To robustly exploit unlabeled records, FedTGNN-SS combines (1) prototype-guided pseudo-labeling with neighborhood agreement, (2) adaptive graph refinement that periodically updates the k-NN graph using learned embeddings, (3) clinical-aware consistency augmentation applied only to continuous variables, and (4) privacy-safe prototype sharing that exchanges only class-level centroids. Across three diabetes-related datasets (GDM: N = 3,525; Pima: N = 768; Early Stage: N = 520) under 10\%-80\% missing labels per silo, FedTGNN-SS achieves 56 significant wins ($p < 0.05$) against 11 federated baselines and attains strong AUROC under extreme scarcity (Pima: 0.8037 at 80\% missing, Early Stage: 0.9634 at 80\% missing).

title: Universal Smoothness via Bernstein Polynomials: A Constructive Approximation Approach for Activation Functions
comment: Accepted to 2026 International Conference On Intelligent Computing (ICIC 2026)
summary: The efficacy of deep neural networks is heavily reliant on the design of non-linear activation functions, yet existing approaches often struggle to balance optimization stability with computational efficiency. While piecewise linear functions offer inference speed, they suffer from optimization instability due to non-differentiability at the origin, whereas smooth counterparts typically incur significant computational overhead through their reliance on transcendental operations. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a general smoothing framework based on constructive approximation theory and introduces the Bernstein Linear Unit (BerLU). This novel activation function utilizes Bernstein polynomials to construct a differentiable quadratic transition region that effectively eliminates singularities while maintaining a piecewise linear structure. Theoretical analysis demonstrates that the proposed method guarantees strictly continuous differentiability and a non-expansive Lipschitz constant of one, which ensures stable gradient propagation and prevents the gradient explosion problems common in deep architectures. Comprehensive empirical evaluations across representative Vision Transformer and Convolutional Neural Network architectures confirm that this approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on standard image classification benchmarks while delivering superior computational and memory efficiency.

title: Skipping the Zeros in Diffusion Models for Sparse Data Generation
summary: Diffusion models (DMs) excel on dense continuous data, but are not designed for sparse continuous data. They do not model exact zeros that represent the deliberate absence of a signal. As a result, they erase sparsity patterns and perform unnecessary computation on mostly zero entries. With Sparsity-Exploiting Diffusion (SED), we model only non-zero values, preserving sparsity. SED delivers computational savings while maintaining or improving generation quality by skipping zeros during training and inference. Across physics and biology benchmarks, SED matches or surpasses conventional DMs and domain-specific baselines, while vision experiments provide intuitive insights into the limitations of dense DMs and the benefits of SED.

title: Foundation-Model-Based Agents in Industrial Automation: Purposes, Capabilities, and Open Challenges
comment: 35 pages, 8 figures, 1 table. Submitted to Journal of Intelligent Manufacturing for peer review. A comparison of classical agent applications and foundation-model based agents is presented
summary: Foundation models, particularly large language models, are increasingly integrated into agent architectures for industrial tasks such as decision support, process monitoring, and engineering automation. Yet evidence on their purposes, capabilities, and limitations remains fragmented across domains. This work examines how mature foundation-model-based agent systems are in industrial contexts, how their functional profile differs from conventional agent systems, and which limitations persist. A systematic literature survey following the PRISMA 2020 guideline is presented, screening 2,341 publications and synthesising a corpus of 88 publications through a structured coding scheme. The results show that reported systems are predominantly at prototype and early validation stages (75.0% at TRL 4-6), with deployment-oriented evidence remaining rare (9.1%). Operational goals are most frequently positioned in user assistance, monitoring, and process optimisation, while conventional production-control purposes such as planning and scheduling are less prominent. Compared with an established baseline for industrial agent systems, the capability profile reveals substantial gains in human interaction (+37%) and dealing with uncertainty (+35%), but a pronounced deficit in negotiation (-39%). The most widely reported limitations concern lack of generalization, hallucination and output instability, data scarcity, and inference latency. A working definition of foundation-model-based industrial agents is also proposed, bridging conventional agent theory, automation-engineering standards, and the foundation-model paradigm.

title: Molecular Representations for Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being used to support scientific discovery. In chemistry, tasks such as reaction prediction and structure elucidation require reasoning about the structures of molecules. As such, LLM-based systems for chemistry must interact reliably with molecular structures. Most previous studies of LLMs in chemistry have used SMILES strings or IUPAC names as molecular representations; however, the suitability of these formats has not been systematically assessed. In this work, we introduce MolJSON, a novel molecular representation for LLMs, and systematically compare it with five common chemical formats. We evaluated each representation with GPT-5-nano, GPT-5-mini, GPT-5, and Claude Haiku 4.5 using a set of 78,045 questions spanning translation, shortest path, and constrained generation reasoning tasks. We observed substantial variation across representations in the ability of LLMs to interpret and generate molecular graphs, with MolJSON consistently outperforming existing formats. On translation tasks, GPT-5 achieved 71.0% accuracy when converting IUPAC names to MolJSON, compared with 43.7% when converting the same inputs to SMILES. For constrained generation, GPT-5 reached 95.3% accuracy generating MolJSON, compared with 76.3% for IUPAC and 64.0% for SMILES. As an input format for shortest-path reasoning, GPT-5 successfully answered 98.5% of questions with MolJSON, compared with 92.2% for SMILES and 82.7% for IUPAC, whilst also using fewer reasoning tokens. We observed systematic errors associated with atom count and ring complexity for SMILES strings and IUPAC names, whereas MolJSON was more robust to these failure modes. Our results show that the choice of molecular representation has a material impact on LLM performance, and that explicit molecular graph schemas, such as MolJSON, are a promising direction for LLM-based systems in chemistry.

title: Counterfactual Reasoning in Automated Planning
summary: Automated planning traditionally assumes that all aspects of a planning task (initial state, goals, and available actions) are fully specified in advance, an approach well-suited to domains with fixed rules and deterministic execution. However, real-world planning often requires flexibility, allowing for deviations from the original task parameters in response to unforeseen circumstances or to improve outcomes. This paper surveys existing works on counterfactual reasoning in automated planning, categorizing them by what elements are changed, when the reasoning is triggered, and why and how these changes are made. We conclude by discussing key findings and outlining open research questions to guide future work in this area.

title: Selector-Guided Autonomous Curriculum for One-Shot Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards
summary: Recently, Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has been established as a highly effective technique for augmenting the math reasoning skills of Large Language Models (LLMs) based on a single instance. Current state-of-the-art 1-shot RLVR models adopt heuristics for selecting instances, mostly based on historical variance in rewards, which we find to be inherently misleading as a measure of transferability value. In this paper, we propose a Selector-Guided Autonomous Curriculum (SGAC) approach, which employs a learnable selector model on a multi-dimensional feature space consisting of success probability, reward variance, output disagreement (entropy), and semantic difficulty level, instead of the static reward variance heuristic. In our empirical evaluation on pools of candidate problems, we observed that output disagreement, rather than reward variance, is the strongest predictor of reasoning gains in subsequent iterations. Leveraging this finding, we develop an autonomous curriculum algorithm for dynamically siphoning candidate problems from a large pool, ranking them by the learned selector, and running micro-bursts of 1-shot GRPO. Our framework is evaluated using the Hendrycks MATH benchmark, with the Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B model serving as the baseline. Our framework obtains an accuracy of 68.0\% on the hold-out dataset, which is better than the accuracy obtained from the state-of-the-art model, 64.0\%, as well as the 1-shot RLVR checkpoint proposed by Wang et al., which achieved an accuracy of 66.0\%. The results confirm that entropy-based intelligent data curation leads to strict reasoning improvement over static training methods, particularly in severely limited data conditions.

title: SCGNN: Semantic Consistency enhanced Graph Neural Network Guided by Granular-ball Computing
summary: Capturing semantic consistency among nodes is crucial for effective graph representation learning. Existing approaches typically rely on $k$-nearest neighbors ($k$NN) or other node-level full search algorithms (FSA) to mine semantic relationships via exhaustive pairwise similarity computation, which suffer from high computational complexity and rigid neighbor selection, limiting scalability and introducing noisy connections. In this paper, we propose the Semantic Consistency enhanced Graph Neural Network (SCGNN), a novel plug-and-play framework that leverages granular-ball computing (GBC) to efficiently capture semantic consistency in a scalable manner. Unlike node-level FSA methods, SCGNN models group-level semantic structure by adaptively partitioning nodes into granular balls, significantly reducing computational cost while improving robustness to noise. To effectively utilize the discovered group-level semantic consistency, we design a dual enhancement strategy. Specifically, (1) a structure enhancement module constructs an anchor-based graph structure, where each anchor is a virtual node representing the group-level semantic carried by a granular ball, then injecting group-level semantic information into the graph structure; and (2) a supervision enhancement module performs label consistency checking (LCC) by combining GBC predictions with model-generated pseudo-labels, thereby producing more reliable supervision signals. SCGNN is compatible with various GNN backbones. During the forward propagation of SCGNN, the vanilla graph and the augment graph are jointly encoded, and their predictions are fused; during the backpropagation, the supervision enhancement module provides enhanced supervision signals to guide parameter updates.

title: Learning Koopman operators for coupled systems via information on governing equations of subsystems
summary: Nonlinear coupled systems are ubiquitous in science and engineering. The analysis and modeling of such systems is challenging due to their high dimensionality and complex interactions among subsystems. In recent years, operator-theoretic methods based on the Koopman operator have attracted attention as a powerful tool for analyzing and modeling nonlinear dynamical systems. Extended dynamic mode decomposition (EDMD) is one of the most popular methods to approximate the Koopman operator. However, EDMD is a purely data-driven method, and it could be unstable and inaccurate for coupled systems under limited data availability. In this paper, we propose a method to learn the Koopman operator for coupled systems using the differential equations governing each subsystem. We also demonstrate its effectiveness through numerical experiments on coupled oscillator systems.

title: Trustworthy AI Suffers from Invariance Conflicts and Causality is The Solution
summary: As artificial intelligence (AI), including machine learning (ML) models and foundation models (FMs), is increasingly deployed in high-stakes domains, ensuring their trustworthiness has become a central challenge. However, the core trustworthy AI objectives, such as fairness, robustness, privacy, and explainability, are hard to achieve simultaneously, especially while preserving utility. This position paper argues that causality is necessary to understand and balance trade-offs in performance and multiple objectives of trustworthy AI. We ground our arguments in re-interpreting trustworthy AI trade-offs as incompatible invariance requirements under different changes to the data-generating process. We then illustrate that causality provides a unifying framework for understanding how trade-offs in trustworthy AI arise, and how they can be softened or resolved through selective invariance. This perspective applies to both classical ML models and large-scale FMs. Our paper discusses how causal assumptions may be applied explicitly or implicitly in modern large-scale systems. Finally, we outline open challenges and opportunities for using causality to build more trustworthy AI.

title: QHyer: Q-conditioned Hybrid Attention-mamba Transformer for Offline Goal-conditioned RL
summary: Offline goal-conditioned RL (GCRL) learns goal-reaching policies from static datasets, but real-world datasets are often partially observable and history-dependent, exhibiting a mix of Markovian and non-Markovian that violate standard RL assumptions. History-aware sequence models such as Decision Transformer (DT) are a natural fit for long-term dependency modeling, yet pure attention is inefficient and brittle when handling local Markovian structure and long-range context simultaneously. Although recent hybrid architectures (e.g., LSDT) introduce local extractors to improve local dependencies modeling, the fixed-window extraction cannot adapt its effective memory to varying dependency lengths in temporally heterogeneous settings, often truncating long-range context rather than compressing its content adaptively. Moreover, sequential offline GCRL faces a key bottleneck: under sparse rewards, return-to-go (RTG) becomes non-discriminative across sub-trajectories, providing little guidance signal for stitching goal-reaching behaviors from diverse demonstrations. To address these, we propose \textbf{QHyer}, which replaces RTG with a flow-parameterized, state-conditioned goal-reaching Q-estimator to support stitching across demonstrations, and introduces a gated Hybrid Attention-Mamba backbone that performs content-adaptive history compression while preserving local dynamics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \textbf{QHyer} achieves state-of-the-art performance on both non-Markovian and Markovian datasets, validating its effectiveness for diverse scenarios.

title: Deciphering Shortcut Learning from an Evolutionary Game Theory Perspective
summary: Shortcut learning causes deep learning models to rely on non-essential features within the data. However, its formation in deep neural network training still lacks theoretical understanding. In this paper, we provide a formal definition of core and shortcut features and employ evolutionary game theory to analyze the origins of shortcut bias by modeling data samples as players and their corresponding neural tangent features as strategies, assuming the existence of core and shortcut subnetworks. We find that gradient descent (GD) and stochastic gradient descent (SGD) lead to two distinct stochastically stable states, each corresponding to a different strategy. The former primarily optimizes the shortcut subnetwork, while the latter primarily optimizes the core subnetwork. We investigate the influence of these strategies on shortcut bias through a continuous stochastic differential equation, and reveal the impact of data noise and optimization noise on the formation of shortcut bias. In brief, our work employs evolutionary game theory to characterize the dynamics of shortcut bias formation and provides a theoretical view on its mitigation.

title: Robust Conditional Conformal Prediction via Branched Normalizing Flow
summary: Conformal prediction (CP) constructs prediction sets with marginal coverage guarantees under the assumption that the calibration and test distributions are identical. However, under distribution shift, existing approaches primarily align marginal conformal score distributions, which is sufficient to preserve marginal coverage but does not control the conditional coverage error at individual test inputs. As a consequence, CP can remain unreliable in regions where the conditional score distributions are mismatched. In this work, we bound the conditional invalidity of CP under distribution shift in terms of the Wasserstein distance between the calibration and test distributions. This result highlights the role of invertible transport in mitigating conditional coverage degradation. Motivated by this insight, we introduce Branched Normalizing Flow (BNF), a two-branch architecture that normalizes a test input to the calibration distribution and transforms the prediction set of the normalized input back to the test distribution while preserving conditional guarantees. Empirically, BNF consistently improves conditional coverage robustness on nine datasets across a wide range of confidence levels.

title: Leveraging Data Symmetries to Select an Optimal Subset of Training Data under Label Noise
summary: The performance of machine learning models often relies on large labeled datasets; however, data collected from diverse sources can contain label noise. Recent work has shown that, in noisy settings, there may exist a subset of the training data on which models can achieve performance comparable to training on a noise-free dataset. A widely used method for identifying such subsets is cutstats, which employs k-nearest neighbors (k-NN) to detect low-noise samples. However, its performance on high-dimensional data remains largely unexplored. In this work, we formally establish that the performance of a classifier trained on a subset of a noisy dataset selected via cutstats is influenced by the accuracy of k-NN. We further demonstrate that, in noisy environments, exploiting data invariance and knowledge of underlying symmetries can significantly enhance the performance of k-NN, bringing it closer to the Bayes optimal classifier even in high-dimensional regimes. Finally, we show that for real-world scenarios, where information about the underlying invariance is only partially known, learnt invariant representations can still facilitate the identification of near-optimal subsets.

title: An explainable hypothesis-driven approach to Drug-Induced Liver Injury with HADES
summary:
Drug-induced liver injury (DILI) remains a leading cause of late-stage clinical trial attrition. However, existing computational predictors primarily rely on binary classification, a framing that limits generalization and yields no mechanistic insight to guide translational decisions. We argue that DILI prediction is better posed as an explainable hypothesis-generation problem.
  To support this shift, we introduce the DILER Benchmark, a dataset that extends beyond binary labels by augmenting a curated set of molecules with mechanistic hepatotoxicity hypotheses derived from biomedical literature. We further present HADES, an agentic system designed to generate transparent and auditable reasoning traces. By combining molecular-level predictions, metabolite decomposition, structural understanding, and toxicity pathway evidence, HADES mechanistically assesses DILI risk.
  Evaluated on the DILER Benchmark, HADES outperforms existing models in binary classification, achieving a ROC-AUC of 0.68 on the Test Set and 0.59 on the challenging Post-2021 Set, compared with 0.63 and 0.50 for DILI-Predictor, respectively. More importantly, we establish a baseline for mechanistic hypothesis generation, where HADES achieves a Hypothesis Alignment Fuzzy Jaccard Index of 0.16. This result underscores the inherent complexity of the task while highlighting the need for advanced explainable approaches in predictive toxicology.

title: How Label Imbalance Shapes Geometry: A General Spectral Analysis of Multi-Label Neural Collapse
summary: This work investigates the phenomenon of Neural Collapse (NC) in multi-label classification, extending its conceptual framework from multi-class learning to general correlated and imbalanced multi-label settings. Although recent studies have identified a ''tag-wise averaging'' structure for multi-label features, this view relies on implicit assumptions of label balance and combinatorial symmetry. Consequently, it fails to account for the geometrical distortions caused by intrinsic label correlations and data imbalance, which are common in practice. We resolve the multiplicity-one imbalance conjecture raised by Li et al. (2024), showing that higher-multiplicity prototypes obey a class-frequency-weighted synthesis rule rather than uniform averaging. To address this, we propose a rigorous spectral-control framework to analyze the terminal phase of multi-label learning under general imbalanced conditions. We introduce the label covariance spectrum $κ_m$, a scalar controlling the distribution-dependent lower-bound geometry, derived from the second-order moment matrix of the label distribution. Contrary to the averaging perspective, our analysis reveals that the centered label covariance spectrum controls the stability of terminal geometry by quantifying the weakest centered inter-class contrast directions. We prove that the classical Tag-wise Averaging emerges only as a special case under perfect orthogonality. Numerical experiments on synthetic distributions validate our theoretical bounds. This work resolves the scaled-average aspect of the imbalance conjecture and establishes a unifying theoretical framework that extends Neural Collapse to complex, imbalanced multi-label settings.

title: The 2026 ACII Dyadic Conversations (DaiKon) Workshop & Challenge
summary:
The 2026 ACII Dyadic Conversations (ACII-DaiKon) Workshop & Challenge introduces a benchmark for modeling interpersonal affect and social dynamics in dyadic conversations. Although conversational affect modeling has advanced rapidly, most benchmarks remain speaker-centric and underrepresent coupled, time-evolving processes between partners, including directional influence, conversational timing coordination, and rapport development. To address this gap, ACII-DaiKon presents three coordinated sub-challenges built on a shared dataset: (1) directional interpersonal influence prediction, (2) turn-taking prediction (next-speaker and time-to-next-speech), and (3) rapport trajectory prediction across full interactions.
  The challenge is built on the Hume-DaiKon dataset, comprising 945 dyadic conversations (743.4 hours of audiovisual data) collected under naturalistic conditions across five languages. The benchmark supports multimodal modeling, temporal reasoning, and cross-context generalization through fixed train/validation/test splits, standardized metrics, and released baseline systems. Evaluation uses Concordance Correlation Coefficient (CCC), Pearson correlation, Macro-F1, and Mean Absolute Error (MAE) depending on the sub-challenge.
  Baseline experiments establish initial reference performance, with best test results of 0.40 CCC and 0.50 Pearson for influence prediction, 0.66 Macro-F1 and 1.50~s MAE for turn-taking, and 0.68 CCC and 0.70 Pearson for rapport trajectory modeling. These results indicate that while current methods capture coarse dyadic patterns, robust modeling of directional dependence and long-horizon interpersonal dynamics remains challenging. The workshop provides a shared platform for rigorous comparison and cross-disciplinary discussion on data validity, evaluation protocols, and culturally aware modeling for dyadic interaction.

title: Hybrid Inspection and Task-Based Access Control in Zero-Trust Agentic AI
summary: Authorizing Large Language Model (LLM)-driven agents to dynamically invoke tools and access protected resources introduces significant security risks, and the risks grow dramatically as agents engage in multi-turn conversations and scale toward distributed collaboration. A compromised or malicious agentic application can tamper with tool calls, falsify results, or request permissions beyond the scope of the subject's intended tasks, which could go unnoticed with current delegated authorization flows given their lack of visibility into the original subject's intent. In light of this, we make the following contributions towards Continuous Agent Semantic Authorization (CASA). First, we propose a hybrid runtime enforcement model that combines deterministic and semantic controls enabled by a zero-trust interception layer. Five deterministic controls enforce structural and data-integrity guarantees over the message flow, while a semantic inspection layer evaluates whether tool call choices align with the intended tasks commissioned to the agent. Second, differently from prior Task-Based Access Control (TBAC) techniques that operate on single-turn interactions, we decompose the semantic layer into two stages: i) a task-extraction step that distills the subject's objectives from multi-turn conversations at the interception layer, and ii) a task-tool semantic matching step at the authorization server that evaluates whether the requested tools are appropriate for the extracted tasks. Third, we extend the ASTRA dataset that we introduced in a prior work, by generating novel conversation-tool datasets with multi-turn interactions containing relevant and irrelevant tool calls for a given task. Lastly, we provide the first experimental results for TBAC under multi-turn conversations.

title: RefusalGuard: Geometry-Preserving Fine-Tuning for Safety in LLMs
summary: Fine-tuning safety-aligned language models for downstream tasks often leads to substantial degradation of refusal behavior, making models vulnerable to adversarial misuse. While prior work has shown that safety-relevant features are encoded in structured representations within the model's activation space, how these representations change during fine-tuning and why alignment degrades remains poorly understood. In this work, we investigate the representation-level mechanisms underlying alignment degradation. Our analysis shows that standard fine-tuning induces systematic drift in safety-relevant representations, distorts their geometric structure, and introduces interference between task optimization and safety features. These effects collectively lead to increased harmful compliance. Motivated by these findings, we introduce REFUSALGUARD, a representation-level fine-tuning framework that preserves safety-relevant structure during model adaptation. Our approach constrains updates in hidden representation space, ensuring that safety-mediating components remain stable while allowing task-specific learning in complementary directions. We evaluate REFUSALGUARD across multiple model families, including LLaMA, Gemma, and Qwen, on adversarial safety benchmarks such as AdvBench, DirectHarm4, and JailbreakBench, as well as downstream utility tasks. Our approach achieves attack success rates comparable to base safety-aligned models while maintaining competitive task performance, significantly outperforming baselines.

title: An Empirical Study of Agent Skills for Healthcare: Practice, Gaps, and Governance
summary: Healthcare automation is shaped by local procedures and organizational constraints, so agent capabilities rarely transfer unchanged across settings. Agent skills, self-contained directories that package reusable procedures for AI agents, are emerging as a procedural layer for adapting healthcare agents across diverse healthcare settings. We present the first empirical analysis of healthcare agent skills, drawing on 557 healthcare-related skills filtered from 58,159 public skills on ClawHub and annotated along ten dimensions covering function, deployment context, autonomy, and safety. We find that public healthcare skills emphasize patient-facing workflow automation and monitoring rather than the diagnostic and treatment-oriented tasks foregrounded in healthcare-agent research; coverage of the healthcare lifecycle and specialized clinical inputs remains uneven; and general technical risk does not reliably capture clinical risk. These findings position healthcare skills as a procedural layer not yet addressed by current benchmarks and risk frameworks.

title: Deep learning-based pavement performance modeling using multiple distress indicators and road work history
summary: The deterioration of pavement is a complex and dynamic process determined by different factors including material, environment, design, and some other unobserved variables. Accurate predictions of pavement condition can help maximize the use of available resources for pavement management agencies through better coordinated preservation and maintenance activities. This paper uses deep neural networks such as the convolutional neural network (CNN) and the long short-term memory (LSTM) to model the pavement deterioration process. In this paper, pavement condition data and maintenance and rehabilitation history collected by the Texas Department of Transportation over the past 18 years were used. Twenty-one flexible pavement condition indicators, including cracking, rutting, raveling, and roughness, collected from more than 100,000 pavement sections were included in the proposed models. Promising preliminary results were obtained. Case study results show that the proposed CNN model outperforms standard machine learning models in predicting pavement condition values.

title: ORPilot: A Production-Oriented Agentic LLM-for-OR Tool for Optimization Modeling
summary: This paper presents ORPilot, an open-source agentic AI system that translates real-world business problems into solver-ready optimization models. Unlike academic LLM-for-OR tools that assume clean problem specifications with preformatted inline data, ORPilot is designed for production conditions: ambiguous descriptions, large-scale raw operational data, and the need for portability across solver backends. The system introduces four novel components: (1) a conversational interview agent to elicit complete problem specifications, (2) a data collection agent that retrieves data independently of prompts, (3) a parameter computation agent to bridge raw tabular data and model-ready parameters, and (4) a solver-agnostic Intermediate Representation (IR) for deterministic, zero-LLM-call recompilation to Gurobi, CPLEX, PuLP, Pyomo, or OR-Tools solvers. Additionally, self-correcting retry loops utilize solver tracebacks for targeted repairs. ORPilot represents the first attempt to target production-level business problems rather than textbook operations research (OR) cases. Evaluation on real-world problems demonstrates promising results. When tested against traditional academic benchmarks: IndustryOR, NL4OPT and NLP4LP, ORPilot outperformed state-of-the-art tools in accuracy on the IndustryOR benchmark and delivered comparable performance on NL4OPT and NLP4LP.

title: Training Non-Differentiable Networks via Optimal Transport
comment: 52 pages, 20 tables, 9 figures, submitted to Transactions on Machine Learning Research
summary:
Neural networks increasingly embed non-differentiable components (spiking neurons, quantized layers, discrete routing, blackbox simulators, etc.) where backpropagation is inapplicable and surrogate gradients introduce bias. We present PolyStep, a gradient-free optimizer that updates parameters using only forward passes. Each step evaluates the loss at structured polytope vertices in a compressed subspace, computes softmax-weighted assignments over the resulting cost matrix, and displaces particles toward low-cost vertices via barycentric projection. This update corresponds to the one-sided limit of a regularized optimal-transport problem, inheriting its geometric structure without Sinkhorn iterations.
  PolyStep trains genuinely non-differentiable models where existing gradient-free methods collapse to near-random accuracy. On hard-LIF spiking networks we reach 93.4% test accuracy, outperforming all gradient-free baselines by over 60~pp and closing to within 4.4~pp of a surrogate-gradient Adam ceiling. Across four additional non-differentiable architectures (int8 quantization, argmax attention, staircase activations, hard MoE routing) we lead every gradient-free competitor. On MAX-SAT scaling from 100 to 1M variables, we sustain above 92% clause satisfaction while evolution strategies drop 8--12~pp. On RL policy search, we match OpenAI-ES on classical control and retain performance under integer and binary quantization that collapses gradient-based methods. We prove convergence to conservative-stationary points at rate $O(\log T/\sqrt{T})$ on piecewise-smooth losses, upgraded to Clarke-stationary on the headline architectures and extended to the piecewise-constant regime via a hitting-time bound. These rates match the known zeroth-order query-complexity lower bounds that all forward-only methods inherit. Code is available at https://github.com/anindex/polystep.

title: Coherent Hierarchical Multi-Label Learning to Defer for Medical Imaging
summary: Learning to Defer (L2D) enables a model to predict autonomously or defer to an expert, but prior work largely assumes flat label spaces. We study the first L2D setting with hierarchical multi-label decisions, motivated by medical-imaging workflows in which findings are organised by clinical taxonomies. In this setting, deferral is a delegation action rather than a label assignment, so treating it as an independent per-label decision can produce deferral incoherence, including taxonomic contradictions, delegation violations, and deferrals of labels already implied by the model's own assertions. We formalise coherent hierarchical deferral under a Selective-Exclusion handoff contract, characterise the Bayes-optimal coherent deferral rule, and show that even nodewise Bayes L2D can be action-incoherent. We then propose two remedies: exact coherent projection, a dynamic-programming decoder over the coherent action set, and Taxonomic Belief Propagation (TBP) with Recursive Policy Optimisation (RPO), a contract-aware joint action model trained through the same recursion used at inference. Across real-reader and controlled-expert medical-imaging benchmarks, naive binary-relevance L2D exhibits non-trivial incoherence. Projection removes it exactly, and fast TBP+RPO drives incoherence near zero while retaining strong utility.

title: Pandora's Regret: A Proper Scoring Rule for Evaluating Sequential Search
summary: In sequential search, alternatives are tested until the true class is found. Standard proper scoring rules like log loss are local, ignoring the ranking of competitors and misaligning model evaluation with search utility. We show that sequential search induces a pairwise structure that overcomes this. By analyzing the expected cost of optimal search under varying testing costs, we derive Pandora's Regret: a closed-form, pairwise-additive, and strictly proper scoring rule. Pandora's Regret both elicits true probabilities and penalizes rank-reversing miscalibrations where distractors outrank the true class. Our construction yields a one-parameter Beta family that balances penalties for rank-swapping versus probability magnitude, while retaining a grounded interpretation as expected search cost. We prove that log loss, accuracy, and macro-F1 rely on implicit decision models misaligned with sequential search. Across 597 MedMNIST models, Pandora-based metrics better predict clinical diagnostic costs than standard alternatives, extending decision-theoretic scoring rule construction to the multiclass setting.

title: AI and Open-data Driven Scalable Solar Power Profiling
summary: Solar photovoltaic (PV) deployment is expanding rapidly, yet detailed, up-to-date information on the spatial distribution and capacity of rooftop PV remains limited. This paper presents an open, scalable framework for detecting solar panels from open data and generating city-level solar power profiles. We leverage foundation vision AI models to detect solar panel geometries from open-source satellite imagery. This avoids manual data labeling and case-specific model training while maintaining robustness across heterogeneous imagery. Detected solar panels are converted into georeferenced polygons, yielding spatially explicit and incrementally extensible inventories. By integrating open weather data, we translate panel footprints into regional solar power profiles. The framework reduces dependency on proprietary imagery, manual labeling, and closed-source models, and offers a transparent and scalable approach for solar planning and analysis. We released the data and an API resulted from this work. For any user-specified building location, our API retrieves aerial imagery, detects rooftop solar panels, and returns georeferenced polygons. This empowers researchers and developers to scan user-defined areas to build solar panel maps and associated solar production profiles, thus facilitating advanced analysis like distributed solar production integration, local power flow optimization, energy tariff design, and infrastructure planning.
